title: Vector P2: strokes/lines split fills + intersecting lines segment each other
description: Depends on Vector P1. In the planar arrangement, adding a STROKE edge across a fill SPLITS the fill into separate faces along the line, and two crossing lines SPLIT each other into segments at the intersection (curve-preserving via P0 kernel). Wire line/pencil/pen + stroke commits through the arrangement.
